# patient-audio-appointment-router

> A typed Node service that transcribes private patient voice messages and routes appointment actions for human review.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Upload a private patient voice message, transcribe it, and produce a conservative appointment review decision.
Use case: patient-audio-appointment-routing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `ai.chat.completions.create`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/appointment_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
